title.zh: 端点可能性丧失与返回

claim.en: Along an actual finite trace under a fixed relational law, all existential endpoint possibilities are preserved exactly when a return path exists. Failure to return has a constructive lost endpoint witness; incomplete questions can hide this loss.
claim.zh: 沿固定关系规律中的实际有限历史，全部存在性端点可能保留当且仅当存在返回路径。无法返回具有构造性的丧失端点见证；不完整问题集合可以遮蔽此损失。

hypotheses.en: Supplied Process.step, configuration identity, finite Trace and endpoint predicates; an actual forward path for the change interpretation.
hypotheses.zh: 给定 Process.step、配置身份、有限 Trace 与端点谓词；变化解释需要实际正向路径。

hypotheses.en: Full endpoint test family is structural, not an omniscient available observation; actual meanings require correspondence.
hypotheses.zh: 完整端点测试族是结构刻画，不是可用的全知观察；实际含义须有对应。

correspondence.en: States articulate relations within one unfolding. A return restores precisely the represented configuration; historical harms and distinct projected recovery targets are not erased.
correspondence.zh: 状态表达同一展开中的关系。返回仅恢复被表示的配置；历史损害及不同的投影恢复目标不被抹除。

detail.en: Both retain endpoint distinctions; no import adapter to DynamicConsequences is claimed.
detail.zh: 两者保留端点区别；未声称导入 DynamicConsequences 的证明转换。

detail.en: One occurring step admits both reversible and non-returning declared laws; a constant observation hides non-return. These are weak-description controls, not refutations of a fully specified constitutive account.
detail.zh: 同一发生步骤容许返回及无返回两种给定规律；常量观察遮蔽无返回。这是弱描述的控制，不反驳完整构成性论述。

limitations.en: Fixed-law endpoint reachability only; configuration equality does not erase history. No physical irreversibility, ethical ranking, law origin or zero-substantive-axiom foundation is proved.
limitations.zh: 仅及固定规律下端点可达性；配置相同不抹去历史。未证明物理不可逆、伦理排序、规律起源或零实质公理基础。

validation_scope.en: Lean 4.29.1: 10 new theorems / 14 audits, all empty named-axiom dependencies; 23 inherited theorems / 28 audits separately rebuilt. Two application examples. Author counterreview; no independent-agent acceptance or empirical validation.
validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1：10项新定理／14项审计，命名公理依赖均空；另重编23项继承定理／28项审计。2项应用例。作者反审，无独立 agent 验收或经验验证。

next_delta.en: Specify actual target-relative restoration in an existing formation/reconstruction mechanism, preserving support and history; do not reconstruct completed path-composition results.
next_delta.zh: 在已有形成／重构机制中落实针对实际目标的恢复，保留支持与历史；不重建已完成的路径组合成果。

history.en: 9 October 2026: checked structural connection and author counterreview registered. Helpers and repeated applications are not counted as independent foundational results.
history.zh: 2026年10月9日：登记经检查的结构连接及作者反审；辅助声明与重复应用不计作独立基础成果。
